sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `runFilter()`'s CAA/EAA artwork initialization never registered the queue-idle completion callback (`_caaQueue.onIdle(_showCaaCompletionToast)`) that `startFetchingProcess()`'s equivalent block already had — so the "🎨 All CAA/EAA artwork loaded" toast and the `#mb-info-display-caa` status-bar segment never appeared after *any* call to `runFilter()` (every ordinary filter/sort action, and every Load-from-Disk hydration), even though the artwork itself always loaded correctly. Fixed by registering the same callback in `runFilter()`, mirroring `startFetchingProcess()`'s pattern; `makeCaaQueue()`'s own `onIdle()` already fires safely even when the queue is already idle at registration time, so this is safe on every `runFilter()` pass.
